name: bookmark
description: Add (or with remove:true, delete) a bookmark - the 'heart'/save - for a component, theme, or template on the signed-in account. Idempotent. Use the id + type from a search or list result.

id.description: The item id (component demo id / theme uuid / template id). A numeric id may be passed as text.

remove.description: Set true to remove the bookmark instead of adding it.

type.description: What kind of item the id refers to.
